# Artifactory Navigator

![Powered by Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-3674a7?logo=python&logoColor=yellow) 
![Powered by Artifactory](https://img.shields.io/badge/DOHQ%20Artifactory-1f2f4a?logo=data:image/png;base64,) 
![Powered by wxpython](https://img.shields.io/badge/WX%20Python-595959?logo=data:image/png;base64,) 

---


This is a simple tool that will log in to Artifactory, and allow the user to interact with the files like they would on a normal file explorer session, including:

- [x] Login screen that checks & saves user credentials
- [x] Simple file explorer with copy / paste / drag / drop
- [ ] Drag / Drop to Copy files into Artifactory  
- [ ] Copy / Paste files into Artifactory  
- [ ] Drag / Drop to Copy files from Artifactory  
- [ ] Copy / Paste files from Artifactory  
- [ ] Bulk delete files from Artifactory
